estimates.assumptions: Pinch of paprika estimated at 2g, a typical modest amount for a seasoning in a recipe for 4 servings.
2 small tomatoes cut into chunks; each small tomato ~100g edible portion, total 200g.
1 whole avocado; average edible flesh weight ~200g after skin and pit removed.
